pll1d5c3-d1e3476.summary: Infers that the only-begotten alone is called Son by nature, since he is of and is the same nature as the Father.
claims: Only the only-begotten is Son by nature.

pll1d5c3-d1e3479.summary: Supports this with Hilary: he is Son by nature because he has the same nature as his begetter.
claims: The Son has the same nature as the one who begot him.

pl-l1d5c3.summary: Concludes that only the only-begotten is Son by nature, because he has and is the same nature as the Father, citing Hilary.
claims: Only the only-begotten Son is Son by nature.
He is Son by nature because he has the same nature as the begetter.
